```{r}
library(JASPAR)
library(RSQLite)
library(TFBSTools)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79)
JASPAR <- JASPAR()
JASPARConnect <- RSQLite::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db(JASPAR))

pfm_set <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(
  x    = JASPARConnect,
  opts = list(collection  = "CORE",
              tax_id      = list(10090),   # Mus musculus
              all_versions = FALSE,
              matrixtype  = "PFM")
)
dbDisconnect(JASPARConnect)

cat("Motifs loaded:", length(pfm_set), "\n")

```

```{r}
EnsDb = EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79::EnsDb.Mmusculus.v79
```

```{r}
species_genome = "mm10"
motif_genes = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r}

gene.promoters <- ensembldb::promoters(EnsDb)
gene.coords <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb)
#gene.promoters <- gene.promoters[gene.promoters$tx_biotype == "protein_coding"]
#gene.coords <- gene.coords[gene.coords$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"]
gene.promoters <- gene.promoters[as.character(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(gene.promoters)) %in% c(1:100, "X", "Y")]
gene.coords <- gene.coords[as.character(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(gene.coords)) %in% c(1:22, "X", "Y")]
gene.promoters$symbol <- gene.coords$symbol[base::match(gene.promoters$gene_id, names(gene.coords))]
gene.promoters <- GenomeInfoDb::keepSeqlevels(gene.promoters, 
                                              value = levels(droplevels(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(gene.promoters))))
old_levels <- levels(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(gene.promoters))
new_levels <- paste0("chr", old_levels)
gene.promoters <- GenomeInfoDb::renameSeqlevels(gene.promoters, new_levels)
GenomeInfoDb::genome(gene.promoters) <- species_genome
my_promoters <- GRanges(seqnames = droplevels(GenomeInfoDb::seqnames(gene.promoters)), 
                        IRanges(start = start(gene.promoters), 
                                end = end(gene.promoters)), 
                        symbol = gene.promoters$symbol,
                        biotype = gene.promoters$tx_biotype,
                        genome = species_genome)

my_promoters <- my_promoters[my_promoters$symbol %in% motif_genes]

print("Matching motifs...")
motif_ix <- motifmatchr::matchMotifs(pfm_set,
                                     my_promoters,
                                     genome = species_genome)
tf_match <- motifmatchr::motifMatches(motif_ix)
motif_df <- purrr::map_df(pfm_set, function(x){
  data.frame(motif_name = x@name, motif_ID = x@ID)
  })

rownames(tf_match) <- my_promoters$symbol
colnames(tf_match) <- motif_df$motif_ID

print("Getting putative TF target genes...")
motif_gene_symbols <- rownames(tf_match)
tf_targets <- apply(tf_match, 2, function(x){ unique(motif_gene_symbols[x]) })
n_targets <- lengths(tf_targets)

motif_df <- motif_df %>% 
  add_column(n_targets = n_targets[motif_df$motif_ID]) %>%
  mutate(gene_name = motif_name) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(cols = gene_name,
                        delim = "::")
```
